paragraphs: Rav Zavda, Rabbi Abba’s father, student of Rav Huna and Rav Yehudah—meaning Rabbi Abba was Rav Huna’s and Rav Yehudah’s student. A teaching by Rabbi Levi appears in Midrash Mishlei,section 1.
